name: gr_triangle_free_regular_half_colorable_two
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (d : ℕ) (h : G.CliqueFree 3) (hr : G.IsRegularOfDegree d) (hd : 2 * d = Fintype.card V) : G.Colorable 2

informal: A triangle-free n/2-regular graph is bipartite — the handshake lemma gives 2e = n·d so 4e = n²; then Uses Mathlib2.bld3_mantel_equality_colorable_two at the final step.
